# SOP-P2-L1-02 Product changeover - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01, EQ-P2-L1-IH02, EQ-P2-L1-SB03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-023, MM-P2-L1-RR01, SOP-P2-L1-05

1. Preconditions
   1.1 Confirm authorization per ECN-2026-023 and change scope in SOP-P2-L1-05.  
   1.2 Verify maintenance status of roll replacement module per MM-P2-L1-RR01.  
   1.3 Ensure EQ-P2-L1-IH02 is powered and communication to line HMI established.

2. PPE
   2.1 Mandatory: heat-resistant gloves, face shield, hearing protection, flame-retardant apron.  
   2.2 Additional: insulated billet handling tools and safety footwear.

3. Key machine setpoints
   3.1 The target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 1180 °C.  
   3.2 The coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 55 L/min.  
   3.3 Do not proceed if actual readings do not meet the values in 3.1 and 3.2.

4. Changeover steps
   4.1 Lock out/tag out feed and downstream equipment following plant LOTO rules.  
   4.2 Remove current billet carrier and install new die set on EQ-P2-L1-RR01 per MM-P2-L1-RR01.  
   4.3 Confirm alignment on EQ-P2-L1-SB03 and secure guards.  
   4.4 Start EQ-P2-L1-IH02 in warmup mode and monitor coil cooling water flow; verify minimum in 3.2.  
   4.5 Heat billets to target in 3.1 before feeding; verify with calibrated pyrometer and HMI feedback.  
   4.6 Run one trial billet, inspect part dimensions and surface; reference SOP-P2-L1-05 for acceptance criteria.  
   4.7 If trial fails, stop, document deviation, and notify engineering per ECN-2026-023.

5. Verification and sign-off
   5.1 Complete the changeover checklist and enter readings for EQ-P2-L1-IH02 setpoints.  
   5.2 Shift lead and maintenance engineer sign below to confirm completion and conformity.

Sign-off:
Operator: ______________________

Maintenance: ____________________

Shift Lead: _____________________
